tools.name: find_bridal_samples
tools.description: Find source-checked US bridal boutiques where a requested plus-size wedding dress sample is published as physically available to try on. Results are not real-time; confirm before traveling.

tools.name: find_at_home_bridal_try_on
tools.description: List source-checked wedding-dress try-on programs for shoppers without a suitable local rack. Results distinguish low sample fees from refundable deposits, expose each published return-clock anchor and day count, and disclose whether a destination is commissionable.
